evidence.title: Two key groups launch Latino voter turnout operation in South Texas

occurrences.checkable_against: State voter-roll challenge and removal records
occurrences.quote_span: “In many places, there have been attempts to try to push people out of the voter rolls, to try to question some of the data,” he said.
occurrences.speaker: Frankie Miranda
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Hispanic Federation voter-turnout operation materials
occurrences.quote_span: Talking to voters, he said, the group will encourage people to vote early and, for those already registered to vote, to check ahead of time that nothing happened with their registrations.
occurrences.speaker: Frankie Miranda
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation voter-turnout plans
occurrences.quote_span: Getting Latinos to the polls next month is a central push of two of the largest Latino advocacy organizations in the country, the Voto Latino Foundation and the Hispanic Federation, according to plans first shared with NBC News.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: 2026 midterm election turnout records and Hispanic Federation turnout-operation records
occurrences.quote_span: “When we do this right, we are going to see a correlation in the participation of Latinos on Election Day,” Miranda said.
occurrences.speaker: Frankie Miranda
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News interview transcript with Frankie Miranda
occurrences.quote_span: Frankie Miranda, president and CEO of the Hispanic Federation, said he believes educating Latinos about their voting rights and hearing their concerns is central to improving turnout.
occurrences.speaker: Frankie Miranda
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Juntos en el 956 event program and recording
occurrences.quote_span: Claudia Lopez, a social media personality in the Rio Grande Valley who focuses on South Texas politics, will moderate the town hall.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: 2028 election results and Latino voting data
occurrences.quote_span: It is going to be the epicenter of the Latino vote for the rest of the country. If the Latino vote in this area swings drastically back to the Democratic side, not only is it going to be indicative of where the Latino vote is today, but it is going to be the beginning of a building block of what people can expect in ’28,” she said.
occurrences.speaker: María Teresa Kumar
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation campaign and spending plans
occurrences.quote_span: This week, the groups are launching a six-figure get-out-the-vote operation that specifically targets Texas’ Rio Grande Valley, where they estimate that nearly 316,000 Latinos who could vote did not participate in the 2024 election.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Voto Latino Foundation, Hispanic Federation and Telemundo event schedules
occurrences.quote_span: Another televised town hall will follow in cooperation with Telemundo, and an end-of-the-month rally to promote voter turnout is in the works.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Event records and video of the Juntos en el 956 town hall in Edinburg
occurrences.quote_span: On Saturday, the groups will host a community town hall in Edinburg called “Juntos en el 956,” where organizers will assist residents with making plans to vote and answer questions.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Voto Latino Foundation organizational plans and public statements
occurrences.quote_span: María Teresa Kumar, president and co-founder of the Voto Latino Foundation, said part of its job is to make sure people understand the electoral significance of the Valley.
occurrences.speaker: María Teresa Kumar
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation

occurrences.checkable_against: Voto Latino Foundation voter-turnout operation records
occurrences.quote_span: “Our focus is to get people really informed, making sure that they turn out.”
occurrences.speaker: María Teresa Kumar
occurrences.subject: Voto Latino Foundation and Hispanic Federation
